We have mass spec: m/z 182.07316494187 (intensity 100) as base peak. Likely molecular ion [M]+? Possibly M = 182.07. Proton NMR: Deltas 7.51 (dddd, J = 8.4, 7.4, 1.4, 0.4 Hz, 10H). So aromatic protons total 10 H at ~7.5 ppm, multiplet pattern suggests two phenyl rings? 10 aromatic H suggests biphenyl? But biphenyl has 10 H (C12H10) molecular weight 154.21. Not 182. So maybe diphenyl ketone (benzophenone) C13H10O, MW = 182.22. Yes benzophenone (diphenyl ketone) has formula C13H10O, MW 182.22, aromatic protons 10. NMR around 7.5 ppm. So SMILES: O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2 . That matches our attempted search. So answer is that SMILES.

We should maybe validate with get_formula_from_smiles to confirm formula matches mass.
